<!-- Generated by scripts/import.mjs from README.md in the harness repository. Edit it there. -->

```bash
ruby bin/check   # syntax and warnings, guardrail scans, all tests
ruby bin/test    # tests only (or: ruby bin/test test/path_test.rb)
```

Tests need no model server, network or GPU. There is no hosted CI: run `bin/check` before opening a pull request
and paste its summary, as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Viktotovich/vb-harness-for-agentic-building/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Design decisions are recorded in
[docs/decisions.md](/concepts/decisions/); a manual checklist for the app is in [docs/ui-checklist.md](https://github.com/Viktotovich/vb-harness-for-agentic-building/blob/main/docs/ui-checklist.md).
